n, t = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

row_count = [0] * n
col_count = [0] * n
diag1_count = 0
diag2_count = 0

ans = -1
for l in range(t):
    ai = a[l]
    i = (ai - 1) // n
    j = (ai - 1) % n
    
    row_count[i] += 1
    col_count[j] += 1
    
    if i == j:
        diag1_count += 1
    if i + j == n - 1:
        diag2_count += 1
    
    if row_count[i] == n or col_count[j] == n or diag1_count == n or diag2_count == n:
        ans = l + 1
        break

print(ans)
